PracticeAttempt.title: PracticeAttempt
PracticeAttempt.description: A record of an exam practice question attempt.

questionId.description: The ID of the question practiced.

chapterName.description: The name of the syllabus chapter.

isCorrect.description: Indicates if the student's answer was correct.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of the practice attempt.

BookmarkedSection.title: BookmarkedSection
BookmarkedSection.description: A statutory section or rule bookmarked by a student.

number.description: The section or rule number identifier.

heading.description: The title or heading of the section.

purpose.description: The summary of the section's statutory intention.

BookmarkedQuestion.title: BookmarkedQuestion
BookmarkedQuestion.description: A high-priority past paper question bookmarked by a student from the Question Bank.

questionId.description: Unique identifier of the question in the Question Bank.

topicTag.description: Specific topic or concept tag of the question.

questionPreview.description: Concise preview of the question prompt.

savedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the question was bookmarked.

UserConfig.title: UserConfig
UserConfig.description: User configuration settings including theme preference and scheduled on-screen timed practice settings.

darkMode.description: Indicates if the dark mode is enabled.

hydrationSoundEnabled.description: Indicates if the hydration reminder chime is enabled.

preferred_practice_time.description: User-selected daily on-screen practice display time in HH:mm 24-hour format.

scheduled_practice_enabled.description: Indicates whether scheduled on-screen timed practice display is enabled.

last_practice_screen_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date string of the last scheduled on-screen practice display.

practiced_question_ids.description: List of previously practiced question IDs to avoid repeats.

time_budget_mode.description: Timer budget allocation mode for scheduled on-screen practice questions.

privacyScope.description: Visibility scope for the student's study statistics.

shareHours.description: Whether to share study focus hours on dashboards.

shareAccuracy.description: Whether to share practice MCQ accuracy on dashboards.

shareStreak.description: Whether to share consistency streak days on dashboards.

todayFocusMinutes.description: Summary of today's logged focus minutes.

totalFocusMinutes.description: Summary of total cumulative focus minutes.

practiceAccuracy.description: Summary of practice MCQ accuracy percentage.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when preference was saved.

caLevel.description: Selected ICAI CA course level (foundation, intermediate, or final).

RevisionPlannerSubjectData.title: RevisionPlannerSubjectData
RevisionPlannerSubjectData.description: Subject-wise revision tracking with completed checkboxes and hours spent.

revisionsCount.description: The number of pre-exam revision loops to display.

chapters.description: A map of chapter titles to their revision progress statuses.

TaskList.title: TaskList
TaskList.description: A study board or task list created by the student.

title.description: The title of the study board or task list.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: An individual study action/target goal in the task list.

cleanTitle.description: Optional clean title without prefix tags.

listId.description: Reference ID to the parent task list.

FocusSession.title: FocusSession
FocusSession.description: A study timer focus session allocated to a subject.

subjectId.description: The allocated CA Final subject ID.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of when the session was saved and allocated.

description.description: Optional notes or comments about this study block.

sessionType.description: Optional session type identifying whether study focus or break.

PeerRequest.title: PeerRequest
PeerRequest.description: A pending or processed study peer linkage request.

StudyPeer.title: StudyPeer
StudyPeer.description: A linked study peer candidate for progress tracking.

FlashcardRating.title: FlashcardRating
FlashcardRating.description: A student's self-assessed confidence rating for an individual flashcard concept.

rating.description: Confidence level from 1 (lowest confidence / need help) to 5 (mastered / high confidence).

category.description: The chapter or topic of the concept.

statutoryRef.description: The statutory standard or section reference.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the rating was set.

PeerChatMessage.title: PeerChatMessage
PeerChatMessage.description: A real-time message exchanged between CA Final study peers.

receiverId.description: UID of the recipient, room ID, or 'group_lounge'.

text.description: The statutory or coordination text content of the message.

subjectTag.description: CA Final paper code tag for doubts or material requests.

isResolved.description: Whether a doubt or material request has been resolved.

resolvedBy.description: Display name of the student who resolved the doubt.

StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: A student-created group chat room for CA Final collaborative revision and doubt clearing.

id.description: Unique room identifier starting with room_.

subjectId.description: Target CA Final subject ID or General.

topic.description: Room focus topic or chapter goal.

isPrivate.description: True if protected by an invite code.

inviteCode.description: Invite code required to unlock private rooms.

creatorName.description: Display name of the room creator.

UsernameRecord.title: UsernameRecord
UsernameRecord.description: A case-insensitive first-come-first-served username registry record.

normalizedHandle.description: Lowercase normalized handle used as document ID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Optional display name of the owner.

/usernames/{usernameId}.description: Canonical registry of all claimed custom usernames enforcing case-insensitive uniqueness on a first-come, first-served basis.

/peerChats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time communication logs between peers for discussing syllabus exceptions and organizing sprints.

/studyRooms/{roomId}.description: Student-created public and invite-code protected group chat rooms.

/users/{userId}/practiceAttempts/{attemp.description: Individual practice session question attempts tracked per user.

/users/{userId}/bookmarkedSections/{book.description: Student's pinned favorite statutory sections for offline or quick review.

/users/{userId}/bookmarkedQuestions/{que.description: Student's bookmarked high-priority Question Bank questions saved to My Bookmarks in Profile.

/users/{userId}/revisionPlanner/{subject.description: The student's custom revision tracking, checkbox milestones, and spent study hours.

/users/{userId}/taskLists/{taskListId}.description: The student's task lists or study boards.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: The student's mapped goals inside various boards/lists.

/users/{userId}/focusSessions/{sessionId.description: The student's locked and allocated Pomodoro study focus sessions.

/peerRequests/{requestId}.description: Pending and completed study peer linkage requests between candidates.

/users/{userId}/peers/{peerId}.description: Accountability study peers tracked by the student.

/users/{userId}/flashcardRatings/{rating.description: Student confidence ratings for individual flashcards to identify and prioritize revision of weakest concepts.
